headline: Iran releases AI video threatening military strikes on Amazon Microsoft and SpaceX
label: BREAKING
caption:
An artificial intelligence video released by Iran has threatened military strikes against major American technology companies.

According to Firstpost, the video targets Amazon, Microsoft and SpaceX because of their alleged links to the United States military.

The warning comes amid heightened regional tensions and scrutiny over big tech contracts with defence agencies.
